objective: The Hooks Store, job 12: the proven lane (SPEC 1.46, decision 39) after the carry-overs. Read SPEC.md at its current version in https://github.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec and jobs/next-job-carry-overs.md there (raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/jobs/next-job-carry-overs.md) for the full wording and tests of every item below; every item is in scope. Carry-overs first. (h) The phantom scroll gap was fixed in job 10; keep its test: at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 with seven findings showing, the column's scrollHeight equals its last child's bottom plus the padding within 2 px, at load and after scrolling the column to its end. (i) The Builder goes fluid (3.2, decision 38): .builder-page.wrap takes max-width 1800px with padding-inline clamp(16px, 3vw, 48px) keeping the safe-area max() on each side; the .b2 grid keeps steps minmax(0, 1fr) and the card becomes clamp(420px, 28vw, 520px) from 1100 px up; rule rows, the shelf and fields fill their column; paragraph text keeps its 65ch measure; type sizes unchanged; the width sweep adds 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 asserting the content edges sit within the gutters up to 1800 px, no sideways scroll, the card inside the viewport. (j) Readable text (decision 41): keep Press Start 2P wherever it is used today; replace Pixelify Sans with Atkinson Hyperlegible for all reading text and VT323 with JetBrains Mono for numbers, addresses, hashes, signatures and the exact request text, same sizes and line heights, both self-hosted as latin woff2 under /fonts with licences in LICENSES and fallbacks declared, the old files and @font-face rules removed; a unit test on styles.css and Playwright assertions on computed font-family for a paragraph, a rule line, an address and the cost number on the Builder and the hook page at 390 and 1440 px. (k) A request id that is not a hook (decision 42): opening #hook/1/<request> for a contracts launch paid through the store (2454, 2456) without a connected wallet must reach the plain "Contracts launch <n>, live" page with its IMD explorer link, worded "Not a hook: a contracts launch for the store", not "Hook not found"; resolve the request from the chain's Requested event the way store bodies are indexed; Playwright covers the ads request id without a wallet. (l) The Promotions panel shows two labelled balances (decision 43): "In your wallet on <promotion chain>: N IMD" from the IMD token's balanceOf, with a low-balance note below 0.1 IMD, and "Deposited for promotions: N IMD" from available(address) with its one-line explanation; both re-read after every transaction; unit test and Playwright. (m) Pay on any chain (decision 43): the promotion chain is where the wallet pays; the hook dropdown lists every live hook the wallet launched on either chain, labelled with its chain; createListing goes to the promotion chain's registry with the hook's own chain id and address; purchase, boost, cancel and withdraw run on the promotion chain; the strip reads featured() on both chains, merges by hook (chain id plus address), sums totals for the same hook and shows one card per hook ranked by that total; the hook page's #ad state looks on both chains; Playwright with controlled RPC: a Robinhood Chain hook promoted from Ethereum reaches Done, and one card for a hook placed on both chains. Then the job itself, SPEC 4.17 and 6.8. (1) Nearest match: when a draft has no exact proven match, matchProvenLaunch picks the proven launch of the same type (A, B or C) with the most block ids in common, ties to the newer launch, with at least one block in common besides token and own-token; the Builder line reads "Adapted from a proven launch: <name> (launch <n>, audited <date>): the swarm removes <blocks> and adds <blocks>"; the request sentence tells the swarm to start from that repository and commit, remove the named blocks and add the named blocks, then audit as a new hook; exact matches keep today's sentence. Unit tests for exact, nearest, tie and no-match, and that a words-only draft never matches. (2) Catalog and hook page marks: a launch in the proven index shows a PROVEN pill on its catalog card and hook page, with "Build one like this" preloading its blocks; the index is read exactly as today from evidence/proven-launches.json at the spec repository's raw URL (now updated by a scheduled script; the file's shape is unchanged, extra fields such as tokenAddress, deployerAddress, poolId and notes may be present and are ignored). (3) The wait line and the cost row read "Usually 30 to 90 minutes, sometimes up to 3 hours. From a proven launch, usually less." and, when a proven match exists, the card adds "This stack starts from audited code." (4) No instant lane, no factory, no free launch: the Builder offers exactly one launch, 0.5 IMD through the swarm; remove any copy that promised an instant lane. Tests: unit tests for (1) to (3); Playwright at 390x844, 1100x800 and 1920x1080 for a draft with a nearest match (the line, the request sentence, the sheet) and for a proven catalog card. Deliver source, dist/ and test results.

Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript, hash routing, base "./", one styles.css of the section 8 tokens (Press Start 2P, Pixelify Sans, VT323 from Google Fonts with fallbacks), a single beige theme by design, no footer, every number and amount in VT323. Before the launch flow, carry over four corrections to job 3's delivery; the first two are visible on the live site. (1) Every visitor sees Could not finish reading Ethereum, because https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com answers HTTP 403 Archive requests require a personal token for any eth_getLogs window older than about 10,000 blocks, so the history walk stops at its second window. Change the Ethereum RPC in public/site-config.json to https://rpc.mevblocker.io for every Ethereum read (logs, eth_call, eth_getCode, eth_getBlockByNumber and the ENS registry): it serves the Intake's whole history, 346 Requested logs from block 26164897, in one call, agrees with publicnode on the newest window, answered 30 whole-history calls in 33 seconds, and sends CORS headers for this site's origin. Keep https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com for Robinhood Chain. (2) site-config.json sets intakeFromBlock 0 on both chains, so a fresh browser walks the whole chain in 10,000-block windows (about 2,600 windows on Ethereum and 9,400 on Robinhood Chain; the Robinhood RPC received hundreds of calls in one page view). Set intakeFromBlock to 26164897 on Ethereum (the block where the Intake's code first appears) and 85300000 on Robinhood Chain (before the Intake's first event at block 85318832), add a per-chain logRange to site-config.json (100000 on Ethereum, 400000 on Robinhood Chain; both RPCs accept these windows and Robinhood Chain holds 68 Requested logs in total) and use it for the Requested and Completed windows in web/src/chain/store.ts; read Completed logs once per chain over the same windows and match them to known request ids instead of walking per request; when a window fails for any reason split it in half down to 1,000 blocks before reporting the chain unreadable. On a fresh browser the status line must reach Read from Ethereum and Robinhood Chain within 30 seconds; add a unit test for the window sizes and a Playwright test against the live RPCs that the status line settles. (3) The resolved-address card for a hook outside the store reads A v4 hook not launched through this store (SPEC 3.1 corrected: hooks such as Hamster Hour were launched through IMD, only not through this site). (4) Remove the chain pill from the top bar: the span with class chainpill in web/src/App.tsx, its styles and the state that fed it. The bar is the logo, the nav, the search box and Connect, with nothing between the search box and Connect, and it still never wraps above 820 px; the chosen deploy chain appears in the Builder's settings and summary, on the launch page and on each card, not in the top bar (SPEC 3.0 and 4 step 3, owner's decision 13). Refresh SPEC.md from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/SPEC.md (now 1.15; section 7.2 records the RPCs, start blocks and windows, and 3.0 drops the pill). Everything else from job 3 stays as delivered. The Hooks Store, phase 1 job 4 of 5: wallets and the launch flow. Implement SPEC.md sections 3.3, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3 and 6.4 (copy-only panel in phase 1). Reuse the wallet layer from https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2254-build-hooks-store-polished/tree/11f246fd8751b48cee018f8d5aa1c6a282e40e0e/src/wallet (EIP-6963 injected wallets, Coinbase Smart Wallet, mobile open-in links) extended to Ethereum 1 and Robinhood Chain 4663 with wagmi and viem; the Connect button keeps its fixed width and shows the shortened address. Step 1 connect on Ethereum or Robinhood Chain, the payment chain; the hook deploys on the chain chosen in the Builder, which may be the other one (SPEC 6.2). Step 2 read priceOf(launch.open@launch-1 as bytes32, imd) from the Intake 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82; refuse if 0 or above 500000000000000000; then IMD.approve(intake, price) with IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 on Ethereum and 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 on Robinhood. Step 3 Intake.request(actionId, bodyBytes, (zero address, 0x00000000), imd, price) with the compact UTF-8 JSON from the composer (refuse above 16 KiB). Each step shows its hash, waits for the receipt, and the next button stays disabled until the previous receipt succeeds. The deploy chain selector offers only the chains site-config.json enables. Without the relay show the warning that a refused body spends the fee and a Copy request button. Type C hook pages that are live show the OPEN THE POOL panel of 6.4 with the computed PoolManager.initialize call, the sorted currencies, fee tier, tick spacing, the typed starting price converted to sqrtPriceX96, and a copy button; sending it from the site is phase 2b. (1) web/src/relay.ts jobStages(): classify nodes by the states api.imd.fun really returns: waiting (queued), working (in progress), accepted (done) and failed; a working implement node makes Building active, a working review or audit node makes Audit panel active, a completed job whose launch is not yet live makes Deploying active; add a unit test fed with a recorded live GET /jobs/:id answer and change web/tests/job5.spec.ts to those names. The Hooks Store, job 7: launch safety. The owner's first real launches showed that a request the swarm cannot finish still spends the fee, so this job makes a post-payment question almost impossible and carries every open finding. (1) Fee wording: in src/blocks/catalog.json every fee sentence (Swap fee, Different buy and sell fees, Whale fee, Volatility fee, Buyback jar, Prize pot, Fee that fades, and any block that says the ETH side or settled in ETH) names the pair currency for both the fee side and the settlement: IMD for a type A launch paired with IMD, ETH otherwise; an IMD-paired request adds the sentence 'do not convert the fee to ETH and do not use any other pool'; 'my wallet' is written as the paying wallet's address; the treasury choice reads IMD's treasury and writes 0x3f252e859a277a86A3967c11D4E054B2f07a1F22 (SPEC 5.1, decisions 17 and 18); update the fixtures and add composer tests for every block under every type and pairing. The Hooks Store, job 8: catalog hardening, so that no request leaves the builder a guess and no sentence earns a high audit finding. The headline items: (1) type B and C requests open with a deployer whose constructor mines the CREATE2 salt itself (no salt argument, no deploy function afterwards), forwards the PoolManager, $owner and the recipient unchanged, and exposes hook(); the site shows 'hook not deployed yet' when hook() is zero; B and C bodies carry the references uniswap-v4-hooks and uniswap-v4-security; the wording IMD's free check accepted is in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/evidence/check-B-deployer.request.json, amended as 4.16 item 1 says. (2) type A requests say beforeInitialize accepts only the IMD launch factory passed as $factory, with constructor arguments PoolManager address, $owner and $factory (item 2). (3) B and C requests restrict initialization to pools whose currency0 is native ETH, key every pool-dependent view and limit by PoolId, and define the token (item 3). (4) every fee side, settlement, threshold and unit follows the pair currency, IMD pairs add the no-conversion and currency-order sentences, and with no fee block the composer writes 'Hook fee rate: 0%.' (items 4 and 9). (5) every request without Yield says the hook uses no outside pool, token, price feed or service; the body always carries owner; type A names the factory, B and C never do (items 5 to 7). (6) fees are computed on the amount traded and a partly filled swap that specified the pair-currency amount reverts; Whale fee, Fee that fades, Volatility fee, Split the fee and Share fees with LPs are tied to one rate and one destination as item 10 says; 'burn' leaves the fee blocks; 'my wallet' is the paying wallet's address and 'treasury' is IMD's 0x3f252e859a277a86A3967c11D4E054B2f07a1F22 (items 8, 10). (7) the Buyback jar buys only inside buyback() with a 3% price limit and keeps the standard token's bought tokens forever, the own token gains burn(uint256), the existing token burns only if it can (item 11); Share fees with LPs and Prize pot as items 12 and 13. (8) the Anti-sandwich sentence, windows starting at the first swap, wallets as tx.origin with the stated limit, seconds instead of blocks, Max swap size on token amounts only, liquidity rules keyed per position, Sunset and Donation rules as items 14 to 21. (9) excludes become lists as item 22 says; Batch auctions is dimmed 'not in this version'; Dynamic LP fee needs the dynamic-fee flag and 6.4 initializes with it; Yield stays dimmed (items 23 to 25). (10) words mode and Custom rule carry the warning and checklist, compose no hidden blocks, never deny owner functions the description grants, and a numbered rule wins; the six-block notice; mulDiv and the own-token supply cap (items 26 to 28). Tests: composer tests for every block under every type and pairing assert the sentences of 4.16 (no ETH in an IMD-paired request outside the opt-out sentence, the deployer and factory sentences, the definition line, the references, 'Hook fee rate: 0%' when no fee block, the excludes lists); the consistency check of 6.7 fails on each forbidden combination; Playwright at 320, 390 and 1440 for the Builder in both modes.
